summary: First motion pass on all six shots, about 21 seconds. Both lines are lip-synced from the board's stems; rain runs under the whole piece and the piano enters at 03.

notes.text: Held wide, only the owner's hands and the rain moving. Opens from black over 1.2s.
Slow push in while she speaks. Check the mouth closes on 'is it?'.
The umbrella clears the top of frame at 2.9s, just before the cut.
She starts reaching for the handle at the very end — the hand-off itself is left to the cut.
Title fades in at 0.9s and holds to 3.4s before the fade to black, per your direction note.
